items.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: I traveled the entire route with Marissa. This was part of a completely shared vision between the two of us

ctx.x: And thank you for getting us here, because I traveled the entire route with Marissa. This was part of a completely shared vision between the two of us to get — and when she told me of your input, you know, throughout the entire week of this process, I was like this is a very special man, so I just want to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
It’s all selfish on my part.
